name: Yumemori
source:
"There comes a point where a daydream becomes reality, and reality becomes a dream."

A short, yet sweet and charming puzzle game about a girl named Aurora, who is trapped in a dreamy room filled with everything she could possibly desire. Explore her wonderland to find a way out and discover the true nature of this fantastical room. All dreams, good or bad, must come to an end... right?


[From [url=https://mythikiwi.itch.io/yumemori]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“总有那么一刻，白日梦成了现实，现实成了梦。”

一款简短、甜美又迷人的解谜游戏。名叫Aurora的女孩被困在一间梦幻般的房间里，里面有她可能渴望的一切。探索她的奇境，寻找出口，揭开这间奇妙房间的真实面貌。所有梦，无论好坏，都必须结束……对吧？

[摘自[url=https://mythikiwi.itch.io/yumemori]Itch.io[/url]]
